_comment: Node ids that intentionally have a docs page without a backend class in ComfyUI. The scanner reads Python source, so it cannot see these: they are never reported as missing documentation and never reported as stale. Keep the three groups when adding entries.

_groups.frontend virtual: Declared by the frontend itself, no python class at all (Note, Reroute, PrimitiveNode, the Deprecated* legacy loaders).
_groups.extension node: Shipped by a bundled or unbundled extension rather than ComfyUI core (TerminalLog comes from ComfyUI-Manager).
_groups.reverted core: Was a core node, reverted or dropped from mainline, likely to come back — keep the page until the feature is gone for good. Check with `git log -S <ClassName> -- '*.py'` in ComfyUI.

notes.DeprecatedCheckpointLoader: frontend virtual: legacy loader kept in the UI only
notes.DeprecatedDiffusersLoader: frontend virtual: legacy loader kept in the UI only
notes.SeedVR2ProgressiveSampler: reverted core: added in #14110, reverted in #14359
